Leaf-level correspondence between two frames

Source: R/map.R
scale_leaf_pairs.Rd

The seam a dimension package overrides when its leaf layer is generated rather than enumerated. Returns one row per leaf (or per leaf and extra identifier, e.g. per grid instant and year).

Usage

scale_leaf_pairs(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A NestedScale.

...

Method arguments: source and target (frame names of x), weight (a weight column, or NULL for the scale's default), and whatever else the dimension needs to generate its leaves – year for a calendar.

Value

A data.frame with columns source, target, w, plus any extra identifier columns the dimension carries. The extra columns must be named in the by argument of the caller.

Examples

head(scale_leaf_pairs(scale_example(), "class", "group"))
#>   source target   w
#> 1     G1     G1 100
#> 2     G1     G1 200
#> 3     G2     GB 300
#> 4     G2     GB 400
#> 5     S1     GB 500
#> 6     S1     GC 600
